still.pick: Two microgreen tray pairs on a wooden bench: one black, and one white grow tray in a green water tray.
still.clean: An empty tray on a wooden bench beside a blue tray of food-grade hydrogen peroxide solution, with a folded cotton cloth.
still.soak: A grey tub beside the tray, with a block of coco peat swollen and loosened by water.
still.fill: The tray filled level with dark, damp coco peat.
still.sow: Seed scattered evenly over the coco peat in the tray.
still.dark: A tray covered by an upturned tray, lifted by pale shoots underneath.
still.light: A full tray of green microgreens under a grow light on a steel rack.
still.harvest: A harvested tray with short cut stems, beside a white bowl heaped with microgreens.
